findings.problem: The question asks why nations would come running to "these people" without saying who they are. "These people" points back to card 8 ("the people He's inviting"), which is no longer on screen.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

findings.problem: "The LORD says it will be a sign that is ___." Here "it" points back to card 13 (the cypress and myrtle growing where the thornbush and brier were, Isaiah 55:13), and card 13 is no longer on screen. The question needs to say what the sign is.

findings.problem: The question reads "The LORD says something of His works the same way. What is it?" This is hard to parse: "works" can be read as a noun (His works) or a verb (something of His that works the same way). The intended meaning is that something of His, His word (Isaiah 55:11), does not return without doing what it was sent for. None of the cited rules is clearly broken, but the wording may confuse the baker.
findings.question: Should the docs require choice-card questions to be clear and grammatical, and should this card be reworded, for example to "In the same way, what does the LORD say will not return to Him empty?"
